title: Around Kyiv by metro
scene: Anna's cousin comes on his first visit to Kyiv, a city of three million people. Anna explains public transport, an inspector checks their tickets in the metro, and the long escalator takes them up to the city center; on the avenue near the park and the monuments a woman says 'Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet', and they ask a policeman the way.

words.ex: We had visitors last weekend.
Thanks for your visit!
Public transport in this city is cheap and fast.
Is the inspector coming today?
We took the metro to the museum.
Take the escalator to the second floor.
The hotel is in the city center.
The shop is on the main avenue, near the park.
Let's go to the park.
The monument stands in the city square.
We walked down the wide boulevard after dinner.
We walked along the promenade by the sea.
We live about ten minutes from downtown.
They built a memorial for the soldiers.

old_story: Anna's cousin Taras is her [[visitor]] today. It is his first [[visit]] to Kyiv. Kyiv has three [[million]] people. Anna loves public [[transport]], so they take the [[metro]]. An [[inspector]] checks their tickets. The [[escalator]] takes them up to the [[center]]. They walk down the [[avenue]] to the [[park]]. Taras takes photos of a big [[monument]]. "Excuse me, [[mister]], your wallet!" a woman calls. Taras says thank you. Then they ask a [[policeman]] the way home.

title: Booking a hotel for the weekend
scene: Max books a cheap hotel in Lviv for the weekend; the booking says four people maximum and a fee for a no-show. At reception the check-in is quick, they get the Wi-Fi password, find their room at the end of the corridor and hear that check-out is at eleven.

words.ex: Is there a hotel near here?
I made a booking at the hotel for Friday.
The maximum for this room is ten people.
The hotel charges a fee for no-shows.
Leave your keys at the reception.
Hotel check-in starts at three o'clock.
Excuse me, what is the Wi-Fi password?
Check-out is at eleven in the morning.
I need a power adapter for my trip to Europe.
We stayed at a cheap motel on the highway.
We stayed in a cheap hostel in Rome.
We stayed at a beach resort last summer.
The trip takes twenty minutes max by bus.
You need a minimum of two hours for this.
I need a converter for my European charger.

old_story: Max finds a cheap [[hotel]] in Lviv. He makes a [[booking]] for the weekend. The room is for four people [[maximum]]. There is a fee for a [[no-show]]. On Friday, Max and Anna go to [[reception]]. The [[check-in]] is very quick. The woman gives them the [[Wi-Fi]] password. Their room is at the end of the [[corridor]]. It is small, not [[deluxe]], but nice. Max needs a phone [[adapter]], and they have one. [[Check-out|check-out]] is at eleven on Sunday. Max and Anna love their weekend.

title: A night in a luxury hotel
scene: Anna wins a night in a luxury hotel in a competition. The concierge meets her in the foyer, her room has a king-size bed and a jacuzzi, she tries the spa and the sauna, and orders breakfast from room service.

words.ex: We stayed in a luxury hotel by the sea.
Ask the concierge to book a taxi.
Please wait for me in the hotel foyer.
We need new sheets for our king-size bed.
The hotel has a jacuzzi on the roof.
We spent the weekend at a spa.
I relax in the sauna after the gym.
We ordered room service for breakfast.
I got a back massage after work.
Our guest room has a queen-size bed.
Please wait for me in the hall downstairs.
The bathroom is at the end of the corridor.
We stayed in a deluxe room with an ocean view.
We bought premium tickets with better seats.
This store only sells high-end phones and laptops.

old_story: Anna wins a night in a [[luxury]] hotel in a radio competition. A smiling [[concierge]] meets her in the [[foyer]]. Her room has a [[king-size]] bed and a [[jacuzzi]]. In the evening she tries the [[spa]]. First she gets a back [[massage]], then she relaxes in the [[sauna]]. In the morning she orders breakfast from [[room service]]. She sends Max a photo: "I never want to go home!"

title: Max's new scooter
scene: Max buys an electric scooter to get to college faster. On the smooth asphalt by the river he races a biker, forgets the speed limit in a tunnel and nearly hits a bicycle with a red reflector; the cyclist stops pedaling, and the incident ends with a shout.

words.ex: He rides his scooter to work every day.
The road is covered with fresh asphalt.
A biker rode past us on a loud motorcycle.
The speed limit here is fifty kilometers per hour.
Is there a tunnel under the river?
I ride my bicycle to work every day.
The bike has a red reflector on the back.
Press the brake pedal gently at the light.
There was an incident on the bus today.
I ride my mountain bike on forest trails.
We often go biking in the mountains in summer.
He rides a moped to work every day.

old_story: Max buys an electric [[scooter]] to get to college faster. On Monday he rides on the smooth [[asphalt]] by the river. A [[biker]] on a loud motorcycle passes him. Max goes faster and forgets the speed [[limit]]. In a dark [[tunnel]] he almost hits a [[bicycle]]. Luckily, he sees its red [[reflector]] just in time. The cyclist stops, her foot still on the [[pedal]]. "Slow down!" she shouts. After this [[incident]], Max always rides slowly.

title: Dad buys a car
scene: Anna's dad is a car enthusiast who watches every grand prix and wants a new automobile for the family. At the dealer's showroom he looks at a supercar and a limousine, but chooses between a sedan and a diesel minivan, takes a test drive and asks about leasing; Anna's driving instructor comes too.

words.ex: He is a big car enthusiast.
The automobile changed the way people live.
We visited the car showroom on Saturday.
He saved for years to buy a supercar.
They rode to the prom in a limousine.
He drives a gray four-door sedan.
Does this truck run on diesel or gas?
We drove the minivan to the beach.
I took the car for a test drive yesterday.
Leasing a car can cost less each month than buying.
Thousands of fans came to watch the grand prix.
He works in an auto repair shop.
The boat has a small motor at the back.

old_story: Anna's dad is a car [[enthusiast]]. He watches every [[grand prix]] on TV. Now he wants a new [[automobile]] for the family. On Saturday Anna and Dad go to a car [[dealer]]. In the big [[showroom]], Dad stops next to a red [[supercar]]. Then he looks at a long white [[limousine]]. "Too expensive, Dad," Anna laughs. So he chooses between a [[sedan]] and a [[diesel]] [[minivan]]. Anna's driving [[instructor]] comes too and gives good advice. Dad takes the minivan for a [[test drive]]. Then he asks the manager about [[leasing]]. Next week the family drives home in a new car.
